author: aishwarya
notes: pair: solely automated decision (Art. 22) vs legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f))
text: We score customers automatically and decline some of them without anyone looking at the case. Is that allowed?

author: aishwarya
notes: the decisive provision is Art. 6(1)(f); Art. 22 is the confusable neighbour
text: We rely on our legitimate interest to score customers for fraud risk. What does that legal basis require of us?

author: aishwarya
text: Is building a profile of each customer's shopping habits already 'profiling' in the legal sense?

author: aishwarya
notes: pair: appropriate safeguards (Art. 46) vs an adequacy decision (Art. 45)
text: We want to send customer data to a vendor in the United States that has no certification of any kind. What do we need?

author: aishwarya
text: Our US vendor is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Do we still need standard contractual clauses?

author: aishwarya
text: Can we reuse the customer data we collected for deliveries to build a new credit product?

author: aishwarya
notes: pair: high-risk (Annex III point 5) vs prohibited practice (Art. 5)
text: Is an AI system that evaluates the creditworthiness of customers high-risk under the AI Act?

author: aishwarya
text: Is scoring people's trustworthiness from their social behaviour and then treating them worse prohibited?

author: aishwarya
text: We will use a high-risk AI system that another company built. What are our obligations as the company using it?

author: aishwarya
text: Do we have to tell users that they are talking to a chatbot and not to a person?

author: aishwarya
notes: Annex III point 4; the GDPR side is Art. 22 if the shortlisting decides
text: Can we use an AI tool to rank job applicants' CVs and shortlist the best ones automatically?

author: aishwarya
notes: Annex III point 4(b): monitoring and evaluating performance
text: Can we use software that monitors how fast our employees work and flags the slowest ones to their manager?

author: aishwarya
text: We want to infer which customers have a health condition from what they buy and target them with offers. Is that allowed?

author: aishwarya
text: Can we analyse customers' faces at the entrance to guess their ethnicity for marketing?

author: aishwarya
text: When exactly do we have to carry out a data protection impact assessment?

author: aishwarya
text: When do we have to consult the supervisory authority before we start processing?

author: aishwarya
text: A customer emailed asking us to delete everything we have about them. Do we have to?

author: aishwarya
text: A customer disputes that their data is accurate and wants us to stop using it while we check. What applies?

author: aishwarya
text: How long can we keep order data after a customer closes their account?

author: aishwarya
text: What counts as valid consent, and can a customer withdraw it later?
